notes: ClownMDEmu (Mega Drive, Mega CD): pkgforge-dev's sharun repackaging of clownmdemu-frontend 1.6.12 (SDL3 + Dear ImGui). Replaces ares (2026-10-10, too heavy for these SoCs); 32X is dropped (ClownMDEmu has none, and no light standalone emulator ships for aarch64).
Mega CD needs no BIOS: ClownMDEmu has its own boot ROM and serves the BIOS calls itself. A bare path is loaded as a cartridge or a disc by its contents (CHD, CUE/BIN, ISO).

-u: one user folder per system, ~/.config/clownmdemu/<system> (configuration.ini there). Its 'Save Data' folder is linked to ~/saves/<system> by user-tmpfiles.d/retroforge-home.conf, since ClownMDEmu has no save-path setting.

Seed: rewinding off (on by default: a rewind buffer every frame, CPU and memory for a feature with no pad binding worth having). Only that key: with a configuration.ini present ClownMDEmu binds no keyboard keys, which a handheld does not miss.

Pad: SDL3 gamepad API with a fixed layout (Mega Drive A/B/C on X/A/B, X/Y/Z on LB/Y/RB, Mode on Back); nothing to bind. Exit: SIGTERM becomes SDL's quit event and the frontend's normal exit (saves written, config saved).
gui_args: the Mega Drive folder's settings (Open has no system).
